scope: Executed actual getSpectrum, calculate and indexValues bodies from viewer.js. Compared 84 source pixels across boundaries, reference line/column intervals, plant/background and deterministic random samples against direct BIL reads and existing float32 extraction/index policy.
tolerance: Raw DN/flags exact; normalized Q absolute1e-6 plus relative2e-7. Derived indices absolute1e-6 plus relative2e-6 because denominator cancellation amplifies float32 versus float64 differences. This does not certify calibration or tissue identity.
